en.headline: About 950 visited Po Pin Chau on Sunday; Monday and Tuesday full
en.dek: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said thunderstorm warnings kept numbers below expectations, while Sharp Island drew about 1,970 people.
body: About 950 people visited the Po Pin Chau section of the High Island Reservoir East Dam on Sunday, the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said. It said a thunderstorm warning that was in force for part of the day kept the count below what had been expected, and that spare slots were released for same-day booking.
Bookings for Monday and Tuesday are already full for the whole day, the department said on its social media account, RTHK reported. Sharp Island recorded about 1,970 visitors on Sunday.

The department said visitor flow on the Po Pin Chau path was orderly. It has stepped up cleaning, patrols and enforcement at the Ham Tin, Long Ke and Sai Wan campsites, which it described as orderly. A joint patrol with the Marine Department, police and the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department reminded visitors not to litter.

The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department has added a smart toilet at Ham Tin and extra cleaning staff. It said the toilet was in good condition, with no food residue left in the basins, and that officers on site were explaining how to use the facilities. The conservation department said management measures would stay in place until the end of the National Day holiday.

zh.headline: 東壩破邊洲星期日約950人到訪 明後兩日預約額滿
zh.dek: 漁護署表示，雷暴警告一度生效，到訪人數較預期低，署方曾釋放即時預約名額；橋咀洲同日約有1970人到訪。
body: 漁護署在社交專頁表示，萬宜水庫東壩破邊洲段星期日約有950人到訪。署方說，雷暴警告一度生效，人數較預期低，並已因應情況釋放名額供即時預約。
港台報道，署方指明後兩日的預約已全日額滿。橋咀洲星期日則錄得約1970人到訪。
漁護署形容破邊洲段山徑人流暢順有序。署方已加強鹹田灣、浪茄灣及西灣營地的清潔、巡查和執法，並形容三個營地秩序良好。漁護署亦聯同海事處、警務處及食環署聯合巡邏，提醒遊客不要亂拋垃圾。
食環署在咸田公廁加設智能環保廁所並加派人手，表示廁所整體衞生情況良好，洗手盆沒有食物殘渣或淤塞，並有人員在場講解使用方法。漁護署說會繼續監察主要景點，管理措施會維持至黃金周完結。
